title: Act: Add deriveStage to LifecycleStepper module
summary: Export deriveStage combining Round and execution status
description: Add a pure exported function deriveStage in LifecycleStepper.tsx that returns the later of the Round stage and the execution stage.

steps.action: Add a Record<string,string> constant mapping execution statuses to stages: RUNNING→DEVELOPING, AWAITING_APPROVAL→PUBLISHING, APPROVED→PUBLISHING, COMPLETED→COMPLETED.
steps.expected: Constant exists; QUEUED and FAILED are absent so they add nothing.

steps.action: Add exported function deriveStage(roundStatus: string, executionStatus?: string): string. Compute execStage = executionStatus ? EXECUTION_STAGES[executionStatus] : undefined. If execStage is undefined return roundStatus. If stageIndex(execStage) > stageIndex(roundStatus) return execStage; otherwise return roundStatus.
